records.outcome: a plugin chosen from a marketplace catalog is installed in Cowork, with any connector it bundles signed in to
steps: Open Customize in the sidebar, then Plugins
Select Browse plugins to see available plugins
Select a plugin and click Install
Sign in if the plugin includes a connector that needs authentication

evidence.quote: Select a plugin and click **Install**. If the plugin includes a connector that needs authentication, you're prompted to sign in.

records.notes: mode: cowork; Default marketplace is Anthropic's official catalog.

records.outcome: a plugin supplied as a package file is installed in Cowork
steps: Open Customize in the sidebar, then Plugins
Select the upload option on the Plugins page

evidence.quote: To install from a file instead, select the upload option on the Plugins page and select the plugin package.

records.notes: mode: cowork; Separate path from browsing the marketplace.

records.outcome: individual components of an installed plugin are enabled or disabled
steps: Review its skills, connectors, agents, and hooks
Enable or disable individual components as needed

evidence.quote: Open the installed plugin to see its skills, connectors, agents, and hooks. Enable or disable individual components as needed.

records.notes: mode: cowork; Written as the third step of the install sequence, but its outcome is component configuration, not installation. Skills and agents appear as tabs; connectors and hooks have their own pages.

records.outcome: a Git repository is registered as a marketplace and its plugins appear alongside plugins from other marketplaces for installation
preconditions: a Git repository containing plugin packages
GitHub or GitHub Enterprise, or a public GitLab or Bitbucket repository
steps: Enter the repository's URL, as https://github.com/owner/repo or the owner/repo shorthand
Install plugins from the repository the same way as other marketplace plugins

evidence.anchor: ## Use a Git repository as a marketplace
evidence.quote: On the Plugins page, select **Add marketplace** and enter the repository's URL.

records.outcome: the registered marketplace offers the latest plugins from its repository
steps: Click Update on a marketplace to pull the latest plugins from its repository

evidence.anchor: ## Use a Git repository as a marketplace
evidence.quote: Click **Update** on a marketplace to pull the latest plugins from its repository.

records.notes: mode: cowork; Refreshes the marketplace listing, not an installed plugin; matches the T-034 alias 'update a marketplace'.

records.outcome: a plugin the user installed is uninstalled from Cowork
preconditions: the plugin was installed by the user; organization-managed plugins can only be removed by an administrator
steps: Open the plugin under Customize > Plugins

evidence.quote: To remove a plugin you installed, open it under **Customize → Plugins** and click **Uninstall**.

coverage_notes: Six procedures extracted: two install paths (marketplace browse and file upload), component enable/disable, marketplace add and marketplace update, and uninstall. The component table, limits table, organization-managed plugins section, automatic update checking, and the Related links state facts with no reader actions and were not extracted.
